items.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB

sentences.en: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB.
sentences.zh: 借助Cloudflare CASB推出自动修复策略。

sentences.en: Today, we’re making Cloudflare CASB more powerful than ever by introducing automatic remediation policies.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们通过引入自动修复策略，使Cloudflare CASB比以往任何时候都更加强大。

sentences.en: This means security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and dispatch custom webhooks, without manual intervention.
sentences.zh: 这意味着安全团队现在可以设计事件驱动逻辑来撤销风险文件共享并调度自定义Webhook ，而无需手动干预。

sentences.en: When we launched Cloudflare CASB , a cloud access security broker, we wanted to provide security teams complete visibility into the posture of their SaaS applications before misconfigurations became incidents.
sentences.zh: 当我们推出Cloudflare CASB （云访问安全代理）时，我们希望在错误配置成为事件之前，让安全团队完全了解其SaaS应用程序的状态。

sentences.en: With a quick, clientless integration, CASB surfaces risks like overshared files, dormant admin keys and tokens, OAuth apps with excessive permissions — continuously, across users in the organization.
sentences.zh: 通过快速、无客户端的集成， CASB可以跨组织中的用户持续地显示过度共享文件、休眠管理密钥和令牌、具有过多权限的OAuth应用程序等风险。

sentences.en: For years, SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) tools such as Cloudflare CASB have functioned as a passive alarm system.
sentences.zh: 多年来， Cloudflare CASB等SaaS安全态势管理(SSPM)工具一直起着被动报警系统的作用。

sentences.en: Most SSPM tools tell you what’s wrong but do not help you fix the issue, placing the burden on administrators to manage an ever-growing to-do list.
sentences.zh: 大多数SSPM工具会告诉您哪里出了问题，但不会帮助您解决问题，这给管理员管理不断增长的待办事项列表带来了负担。

sentences.en: A single misconfigured file-sharing policy across a Google Workspace tenant can generate thousands of findings in seconds, and even a disciplined team faces a window between detection and remediation measured in hours or days — more than enough time for a sensitive file to be downloaded, forwarded, or indexed.
sentences.zh: 跨Google Workspace租户的单个配置错误的文件共享策略可以在几秒钟内生成数千个发现，即使是一个有纪律的团队也面临着以小时或几天为单位的检测和修复之间的窗口--足够的时间来下载、转发或索引敏感文件。

sentences.en: With automatic remediation policies, CASB customers can now configure the actions that should be invoked immediately after a new finding is identified.
sentences.zh: 借助自动修正策略， CASB客户现在可以配置在识别出新发现后应立即调用的操作。

sentences.en: Shifting from reactive to proactive When we launched manual remediation actions earlier this year, we gave security teams the ability to resolve misconfigurations directly from the Cloudflare dashboard.
sentences.zh: 从被动式改为主动式今年早些时候，我们推出了手动补救措施，让安全团队能够直接从Cloudflare仪表板解决错误配置问题。

sentences.en: This removed the need for customers to log in to multiple SaaS portals to take action on the security and content findings detected by Cloudflare CASB.
sentences.zh: 这消除了客户登录多个SaaS门户对Cloudflare CASB检测到的安全和内容调查结果采取行动的必要性。

sentences.en: Still, this required a human to confirm and initiate each individual remediation — even if they’d seen this exact finding type before.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这需要一个人来确认并启动每个单独的补救措施--即使他们以前见过这种确切的发现类型。

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Scheduler Preemption for In-Place Pod Resize (Alpha)

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Scheduler Preemption for In-Place Pod Resize (Alpha).
In Kubernetes, resource allocation has historically been a static decision made during a Pod's initial scheduling and placement.

With the graduation of the core in-Place Pod resize feature to General Availability in v1.35, application developers and cluster operators gained the powerful ability to dynamically adjust CPU and memory allocations of running containers without incurring disruptive restarts or application downtime.

However, in-place resizing introduced a unique resource scheduling gap: if a running Pod requested a resource scale-up that exceeded the host node's allocatable headroom, the Kubelet was forced to mark the request as Deferred .
The Pod would remain parked in this state indefinitely, waiting for resources on the node to naturally free up.
To bridge this scheduling gap, Kubernetes v1.37 introduces scheduler preemption for in-place Pod resize (Alpha), behind the InPlacePodVerticalScalingSchedulerPreemption feature gate.

This feature allows the Kubernetes scheduler to actively free up capacity on a fully-utilized node by preempting lower-priority workloads, enabling the pending in-place resizes of critical, higher-priority applications to succeed.
The "deferred" resize challenge To understand why this preemption mechanism is needed, it is helpful to look at how Kubernetes handles running Pod resizing.

When a user or controller (such as the Vertical Pod Autoscaler ) updates the resource requests of an active container, the Kubelet evaluates whether the underlying node has enough spare allocatable capacity to fulfill the increase.
If the node's resources are fully utilized and cannot satisfy the new limits, the Kubelet sets the container's resizeStatus (reported in the Pod's status.containerStatuses[] ) to Deferred .

Unlike an Infeasible resize request (which is immediately rejected because it exceeds physical machine boundaries, namespace limit ranges, or admission quotas) a Deferred status indicates that the request is valid but is temporarily unable to be actuated, waiting until node capacity becomes available.
Before the introduction of this preemption mechanism, a Pod's in-place resize scale-up request could become permanently blocked if the node was heavily utilized.
